summary.result: The comparative analysis reveals that improvements in air quality are anticipated to result in further increases in both the annual mean temperature (+0.24K) and the frequency of the warmest day (TX90p; 7.7 additional days) by the mid-21st century (2045 ~ 2054) compared to the present-day climate (1995 ~ 2014).
summary.background: Similarly, the annual mean precipitation and extreme precipitation amount (R95p) are projected to increase by approximately 3.27% and 11.40% in mid-21st century, respectively.
summary.method: In contrast to temperature, the primarily climate responses of precipitation increases exhibit significantly depending on region.
